_doc: Real-data sources for AirPower. location 'local': fetched by tools/fetch_real_data.py into data/raw/<id>/. location 'aerotwin': already fetched and prepared by AeroTwin, read in place from $AEROTWIN_DATA/<path> (not copied; NGAFID alone is ~15 GB raw). status: available | to_fetch | to_verify (licence or access still to be checked before use). See docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 4.

sources.title: NASA C-MAPSS turbofan degradation simulation (Saxena et al. 2008), FD001-FD004
sources.licence: US Government work, public (NASA Prognostics Data Repository)
sources.covers: Engine RUL model (A1); run-to-failure trajectories replayed as engine HUMS in FleetSim (held-out units only, see data_prep/cmapss.py)
sources.note: Extracted text files copied from AeroTwin data/raw/cmapss/extracted on 2026-10-05; fetching the zip re-creates them (python -m data_prep.cmapss extract)

sources.title: NGAFID aviation maintenance dataset, 2-day subset (Yang et al. 2022, arXiv:2210.07317), harmonised by AeroTwin
sources.covers: Pre-maintenance risk (A2): 11,446 real flights before / after unplanned maintenance, 19 issue labels, 5 folds; healthy flights for detection thresholds (A5)

sources.title: NGAFID all flights (28,935 flights), harmonised by AeroTwin
sources.covers: Larger healthy / unhealthy population for A2 and sensor statistics

sources.title: CWRU bearing + SEU gearbox vibration windows with edge DSP features, prepared by AeroTwin
sources.licence: CWRU: public research data, cite Smith & Randall 2015. SEU: research use with citation, not redistributed
sources.covers: Gearbox / bearing fault classes (A3); healthy-to-fault feature trajectories for helicopter gearbox HUMS in FleetSim

sources.title: NASA Ames PCoE Li-ion battery ageing (Saha & Goebel 2007), per-cycle capacity, prepared by AeroTwin
sources.licence: US Government work, public (NASA Prognostics Data Repository)
sources.covers: Battery RUL (A4); capacity-fade trajectories for battery HUMS in FleetSim

sources.title: FAA Service Difficulty Reports, calendar years 2020-2025 (one CSV per year)
sources.licence: US Government work (FAA), public; no use restrictions stated on the download page (checked 2026-10-05); not redistributed
sources.covers: Defect text -> ATA chapter (A7, label = first two digits of JASCCode); real repeat-defect and repeat-serial analysis (A8)
sources.note: Download page https://www.faa.gov/av-info/download_SDR; files served from external.apic4e.faa.gov without Content-Length

sources.title: MaintNet aviation maintenance logbook text (Akhbardeh et al., COLING 2020)
sources.covers: Abbreviation / typo normalisation and defect-text classification (A7)
sources.note: Not needed for Phase 4: FAA SDRS provides labelled real defect text. Kept for abbreviation normalisation later.

sources.title: NASA N-CMAPSS turbofan run-to-failure under real flight conditions (Arias Chao et al. 2021)
sources.licence: US Government work, public (NASA Prognostics Data Repository)
